set.body: S2.9 portability follow-up. Register bundled startup fonts through the injected platform Fonts service, perform File Reveal through the current named project and ExternalOpen with visible failure, and use the platform Scheduler for status/save times. Keep explicit fixture defaults working; no OS reveal during automated tests. Verify actual native menu effects, deterministic injected clock, font request/error accounting, cancellation/replacement safety and existing lifecycle tests. Update PORTING Known gaps only for implemented routes. Parent still needs independent DataEmpty board parity. Qualify and land before closure.
set.title: Complete native lifecycle font, reveal and clock platform wiring
